# Animated Men Pack

The character model in `Assets/Resources/Characters/Smooth_Male_Casual.fbx`
comes from Quaternius' **Animated Men Pack**.

- Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/animatedmen.html
- Author: Quaternius
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication)

The model is redistributed here under CC0 and recolored/configured at runtime for
the mover prototype. The original embedded skeleton animations are retained.
